---
title: "quartoWidgets — Non-Layered Polygon Selector (Land van Cuijk)"
subtitle: "Single-level polygon map → sunburst chart (no gemeente drill-down)"
format:
  html:
    embed-resources: true
    page-layout: full
execute:
  echo: false
  warning: false
---

```{r setup, message=FALSE}
library(quartoWidgets)
library(sf)
library(here)

# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# 1.  Load shapefile and prepare GeoJSON
#     The shapefile has a single attribute column: "Gebdsnm" (56 areas).
#     No gemeente column exists — so we skip dissolve_by/extra_cols.
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
shp_path <- here("custom-shapefile/lvc_ingedeelde_gebieden.shp")

gebied_geo <- geo_prepare(
  path         = shp_path,
  name_col     = "Gebdsnm",
  simplify_tol = NULL
)

# Quick sanity check — feature_names should be populated
stopifnot(length(gebied_geo$feature_names) > 0)
cat("Loaded", length(gebied_geo$feature_names), "polygons\n")
```

```{r synthetic-data}
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# 2.  Synthetic indicator data
#     The "gebied" column values MUST match the Gebdsnm values exactly
#     so that polygon clicks correlate with chart data.
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
set.seed(42)

gebieden <- gebied_geo$feature_names   # from the shapefile

domains    <- c("Lichamelijke gezondheid", "Mentaal Welbevinden")
themes     <- list(
  "Lichamelijke gezondheid" = c("Beweging",  "Voeding"),
  "Mentaal Welbevinden"     = c("Gevoelens", "Hinder")
)
indicators <- list(
  Beweging  = c("Sport",   "Bewegen"),
  Voeding   = c("Groente", "Gewicht"),
  Gevoelens = c("Geluk",   "Stress"),
  Hinder    = c("Geluid",  "Overlast")
)

rows <- list()
for (gb in gebieden) {
  for (domain in domains)
    for (theme in themes[[domain]])
      for (indicator in indicators[[theme]]) {
        rows[[length(rows) + 1L]] <- data.frame(
          gebied    = gb,
          domain    = domain,
          theme     = theme,
          indicator = indicator,
          waarde    = sample(10:95, 1),
          stringsAsFactors = FALSE
        )
      }
}
gebied_data <- do.call(rbind, rows)

# Reference average across all gebieden per indicator
ind_key <- paste(gebied_data$domain, gebied_data$theme,
                 gebied_data$indicator, sep = "|")
gebied_data$totaal_gemiddelde <- ave(
  gebied_data$waarde, ind_key, FUN = mean)
```

```{r widget-data}
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# 3.  Initialise interactive widget data
#     Single filter level: "gebied".  No gemeente cascade.
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
wd <- widget_data(
  data            = gebied_data,
  hierarchy_cols  = c(domain    = "Domein",
                      theme     = "Thema",
                      indicator = "Indicator"),
  filters         = c(gebied = "Gebied"),
  score_col       = "waarde",
  comparison_cols = c(totaal_gemiddelde = "Land van Cuijk"),
  id              = "lvc"
)
wd
```

---

## Selectie

Klik op een gebied in de kaart om de gezondheidsdata te bekijken.

::: {.columns}

::: {.column width="40%"}

**Gebied (klik op de kaart)**

```{r polygon-selector}
polygon_selector(
  wd,
  geo              = gebied_geo,
  filter           = "gebied",
  geo_name_prop    = "Gebdsnm",
  layered          = FALSE,
  zoom_to_visible  = TRUE,
  selected_stroke_width = 3
)
```

:::

::: {.column width="25%"}
```{r sunburst}
#| layout-nrow: 2
sunburst_chart(wd)
widget_gauge(wd)
```
:::

::: {.column width="35%"}
```{r detail-panel}
widget_header(wd)
widget_table(wd)
widget_plot(wd)
```
:::
